title: Triplicate kith_to_jmap error mapper — consolidate to shared helper
description: SEC1/SEC3 finding: contact.rs, chat.rs (inline), and message.rs each define their own KithError→JmapError mapping. message.rs has the most complete version (handles KithError::Jmap passthrough). When new KithError variants are added, all three must be updated. Consolidate to one function in kith-jmap or kith-core.
